title: HyperLapse
content: HyperLapse is a form of time lapse video where the camera is moved a fixed interval for each frame, resulting in a rapid movement through a time-shifted space. (Direct link to video)This sequence if byGeoff Tompkinson, who also did ahyperlapse visit to the Hermitagemuseum, where you drift through the galleries and the humans appear like hyper insects.The technique is low-budget but time-consuming. (Direct link to video) Griffin Hammond at IndyMogul shows how it's done in this video.
